The Astral Stair Map is located to the right from the Astral Stair starting area (where the

Merchant is found), guarded by enemies. It can be located by walking to the bottom-left of the Merchant and entering the closest teleportation door, which will teleport the player to the right. Subsequent doors that lead to the Astral Stair Map can be found on the right of each of the new rooms. The Astral Stair Map's location is tracked by a green arrow on the player's screen. Once the Astral Stair Map has been collected, it will no longer appear on the map.
